visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a white button-down shirt, stands inside a modern restaurant. He speaks enthusiastically to the camera with high facial expressions. Above him, Japanese and Taiwanese flag icons are displayed. The background shows wooden interior panels and warm lighting. (2) Close-up shots of various raw meat cuts on black and white square plates are shown. The meat exhibits very high white marbling against deep red tissue. A restaurant logo with the text "Power of Meat" glows in neon white on a wall. (3) The man is seen grilling thick cuts of beef over a charcoal fire inside a metallic grill. Bright orange flames flare up as grease hits the embers. He uses long metal tongs to flip the meat expertly. He eats with a satisfied smile. (4) The man wears a black tank top and a black cap backwards. He holds a smartphone displaying a calculator app. He switches between looking at a physical menu and tapping numbers on the screen, appearing intensely focused and somewhat stressed by the costs. (5) A shot of large steaks on the grill sizzling. The man with the cap eats meat with wide eyes and aggressive chewing motions. He holds a beer glass, clinking it with a friend's glass. He looks overwhelmed but determined to eat more. (6) Back to the man in the white shirt. He looks directly at the camera with a confused and curious facial expression, tilting his head slightly. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. The restaurant interior with wooden textures is visible behind him.

(3) [Subtitle]: 聽說他們最近推出的... 超好吃. (4) [Subtitle]: 好了，都來吃到飽了... 那當然要好好享... (5) [Subtitle]: 這個A5和牛... 北海道生食級干貝等... 各種海鮮... (6) [Subtitle]: 現切和牛嫩肩牛排... 現切肋眼牛排... 而且這裡還有... 專人桌邊現切... narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video humorously contrasts the cultural attitudes of Japanese and Taiwanese people toward 'all-you-can-eat' buffets. Using two distinct personas, it shows the Japanese side focusing on emotional satisfaction and food quality, while the Taiwanese side focuses on calculating costs to ensure maximum value for money. It effectively promotes the restaurant 'Power of Meat' while entertaining viewers with cultural observational comedy.
